title: yencoding: add tests for tab-separated name= field and line= clamping to 255
description: Two header-parsing gaps: (1) find_name_param only matches space before name=, not tab; add a test confirming tab-separated headers parse correctly (or document the known limitation); (2) add test that line=300 in =ybegin produces line_length=255 in decoded YencMetadata.
